result.raw_final:
Found three gluten-free chocolate chip cookie recipes with no nuts listed among the ingredients:

- [Eat With Clarity — Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies](https://eatwithclarity.com/gluten-free-chocolate-chip-cookies/) — The author describes these as nut-free. Uses a gluten-free 1:1 flour blend, butter, sugars, egg, and chocolate chips. Chill 2 hours; bake at 350°F for 10–14 minutes. Rated 4.94/5 from 112 votes.
- [Mama Knows Gluten Free — Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies](https://www.mamaknowsglutenfree.com/gluten-free-chocolate-chip-cookies/) — Uses gluten-free flour with xanthan gum, butter, sugars, egg, and chocolate chips. Bakes at 375°F for 8–10 minutes, with no chilling required. Rated 4.64/5. The page doesn’t specifically label it nut-free, so check ingredient packaging and cross-contact information if that matters.
- [Against All Grain — Nut-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies](https://againstallgrain.com/2018/07/13/nut-free-chocolate-chip-cookies/) — Explicitly labeled nut-free and tagged gluten-free. Uses tahini (sesame), arrowroot, egg white or flax egg, and chocolate. Makes about 12; bake at 350°F for 12–15 minutes. The author says sunflower seed butter can replace the tahini.

For a serious allergy, check the flour, chocolate, and other product labels for nut warnings and cross-contact risk; “nut-free” recipe ingredients alone can’t guarantee allergen safety.
